method: Primary documentation read; quote is exact short source wording; reviewed_definition is reviewer paraphrase/inference. No product execution.

systemctl.locator: status, lines131-149; start, lines179-183; unit-name suffix rules
systemctl.quote: Show terse runtime status information about one or more units, followed by most recent log data from the journal.
systemctl.reviewed_definition: status UNIT reports a human-readable service snapshot and recent journal lines; output may be ellipsized. start UNIT requests activation. Neither proves lasting application health, network connectivity, or successful repair. An omitted unit suffix is treated as .service for these commands.

journald.locator: Storage; SystemMaxUse and RuntimeMaxUse; MaxRetentionSec, lines112-127
journald.quote: The maximum time to store journal entries.
journald.reviewed_definition: Journald can retain captured kernel entries independently of the kernel ring buffer, but collection, storage mode, space limits, rotation and configured retention determine what remains. A query cannot guarantee that an hours-old event was captured or is still retained.

ping.quote: Stop after sending count ECHO_REQUEST packets.
ping.reviewed_definition: ping -c 4 1.1.1.1 sends four ICMP echo requests to that IPv4 address. Illustrated replies/loss/latencies explain possible output, not fixed current measurements. ICMP success does not establish DNS or all outbound application reachability.

nslookup.reviewed_definition: Giving a host name as first argument selects a noninteractive DNS lookup; an optional second argument selects the resolver. Returned resolver/addresses vary. nslookup vast.ai is valid lookup syntax; sample addresses are illustrative.

curl.quote: Request only IPv4 addresses when resolving hostnames, and not for example any IPv6.
curl.reviewed_definition: curl -4 requests IPv4 name resolution; a URL without an explicit scheme defaults to HTTP for the ifconfig.me hostname. The command does not test HTTPS or inbound reachability.

ifconfig.version: service's own Command Line Interface documentation read2026-09-15
ifconfig.locator: Command Line Interface lines16-18; no request identity retained
ifconfig.reviewed_definition: The service documents curl ifconfig.me as returning the observed request IP address. This proves the documented interface only, not the user's current egress IP or uninterrupted availability.

rfc5737.reviewed_definition: 203.0.113.0/24 is reserved for documentation; the page's203.0.113.45 is an intentional example, not a measured routable Host address.

fabric.locator: Introduction lines80-117; Checking Fabric Manager Status lines335-339
fabric.reviewed_definition: NVIDIA describes Fabric Manager for NVSwitch systems and NVLSM on the applicable newer NVSwitch architecture; status is checked on the Host. A container's NCCL error is a communication symptom and does not observe this host systemd service. Not every HGX/DGX generation uses NVLSM.

docker_permissions.locator: Manage Docker as non-root user lines28-43
docker_permissions.quote: By default it's the root user that owns the Unix socket
docker_permissions.reviewed_definition: The standard rootful Docker daemon socket requires root/sudo or authorized group access. Rootless Docker is a documented exception. This Host troubleshooting page assumes the standard rootful installation; a grep exit1 indicates no matching line, not a successful daemon query.

nvidia_driver.quote: Return code 9 - NVIDIA driver is not loaded
nvidia_driver.reviewed_definition: NVIDIA distinguishes driver-not-loaded from device-inaccessible/fallen-off-bus and library/query failures. Failure to communicate with the driver does not alone establish that a GPU disappeared from the PCI bus. The original literal's universal invisible-to-system conclusion exceeds the diagnostic.

xid79.version: rolling official Xid catalog guide read2026-09-15
xid79.quote: 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
xid79.reviewed_definition: NVIDIA's Xid example identifies79 as a GPU fallen off the bus. The Host quick-route row directs investigation toward PCIe/power/riser hardware paths; it does not identify a unique failed component.

calculator.locator: title and introduction lines40-43; Automatic Payouts line60 is separately retained as policy conflict
calculator.reviewed_definition: The official Vast site exposes an earnings-calculator page for estimating income using pricing and expected utilization. Navigation to this resource is valid. Its other commercial/payout assertions are not accepted by this source review.

market_ui.version: published upstream guide read2026-09-15; not the unpublished closure page
market_ui.quote: Availability & Pricing — Historical supply/demand counts and P10/median/P90 pricing over time
market_ui.reviewed_definition: The existing published Vast guide links cloud.vast.ai/host/market/ and defines Availability & Pricing as historical counts and price percentiles. The source establishes the intended dashboard location and view meaning, not a fresh authenticated observation, update cadence, or actual current prices.

dlperf.quote: DLPerf (Deep Learning Performance) is our scoring function that estimates performance for typical deep learning tasks.
dlperf.reviewed_definition: The official FAQ defines DLPerf as an estimate for typical deep-learning performance. The glossary makes only that definition/comparison claim; no exact benchmark score or universal predictive accuracy is inferred.

keys.quote: You can reset an API key by clicking the Reset button.
keys.reviewed_definition: The published key guide locates API-key management/reset in the console Keys section and describes generating a replacement value. The associated sharing instruction is conservative advice, not a guarantee against disclosure.

api_keys.locator: Authentication/account scope lines103-104; security tips lines227-232
api_keys.quote: API keys authenticate your requests to Vast.ai.
api_keys.reviewed_definition: Keys authorize programmatic account access, with scoped permissions available. Host machine operations use the authenticated owner context; an owned/shared-team resource requires a key with matching ownership/permissions. This is access guidance, not a proof that any present key has those permissions.

cli_link.locator: web endpoint response title; cloud console shell; published source links retained separately
cli_link.reviewed_definition: The given official console URL responds as the Vast console shell. The literal is a navigational CLI-install link; existing repository links identify the CLI/API-key setup destination. Static routing acceptance does not claim an installer ran or assert the current authenticated screen content.

udp.reviewed_definition: Docker publishes TCP and UDP separately; a TCP mapping or successful TCP probe does not establish UDP mapping/reachability. A routing row can point to the UDP protocol investigation without identifying the precise root cause.
